source: measured on BDS 1.26.51 with the bds-sweep blocks job, 2026-10-30 UTC

conventions.arena: stone floor at y=-61 (x -10..24, z -12..24), survival player standing on it (feet y=-60), noon, clear sky, peaceful (the cake scenario runs on easy), randomtickspeed 0; the player has resistance V so explosions leave it alive; every scenario starts from a fresh arena with no actors
conventions.faces: 0 down, 1 up, 2 north (-z), 3 south (+z), 4 west (-x), 5 east (+x)
conventions.placement: steps with "use" are the player's right-clicks with the held item (placements, levers, block uses); everything else is /setblock or the listed commands
conventions.ticks: the watched cells and the actors are read once per server tick; tick 0 is the server tick in which the plugin sent the use order or ran the commands; a change at tick n was first seen n ticks later; the client sends the click about a tick after the order
conventions.cells: before/after/changes give block states in block state notation; cells labelled "x,y,z" belong to a watched region and are listed only when they changed
conventions.actors: non-player actors that appeared (first seen position and velocity in blocks per tick, item stack for item actors) or went away (last seen position), by tick
conventions.held_after: the selected hotbar stack after the step: [item, count, data], null when empty
conventions.packets: packets the player received after the step started (attributed by arrival after the step mark), identical ones merged with a "times" count: sounds (LevelSoundEvent), play_sounds (PlaySound, block position / 8), level_events and level_events_generic (id, usual protocol name, data; posNx/y/z fields listed as positions), block_events, block_actor_data (network NBT decoded), add_actor (identifier, runtime id, position, velocity, fuse when set), add_item_actor (item, count, position, velocity), remove_actor, actor_events, actor_data (non-player actors only: per actor the packet count, the fuse values, a countdown by one written first..last, and the flags of non-item actors), actor_motion (SetActorMotion per actor), messages (TextPacket, harness command feedback left out), spawn_position, hunger (changes of player.hunger/player.saturation); block runtime ids in sound and level event data are written as the block state they denote; block_update_packets counts the block update packets
